title: An amazing app with annoying notifications!
body:
A seriously amazing app.
I used it for years, and it has come a long way.
It helped me change my life to the better, and I built new habits for life because of it (I still drink water first thing when I wake up from sleep).
But, I stopped using it recently, because of the annoying notifications. I only need a notification for each of my routines, and not 10 notifications a day for stuff that I won’t actually need or use. Too many notifications dilute the effects intended. And turning them all off defies the purpose.
It would be nice to be able to customize which notifications we want and which we don’t!

title: Great work, but
body:
I can clearly see how much work was put into this app. I appreciate how it’s well designed with variety of activities. However, I couldn’t stop feeling nerve wrecked since the first day I downloaded the app. It’s so annoying when the app keeps using your name almost every time a message is shown, not to mention how it keeps directing you as a kindergarten kid. I know some people might like this, but personally I don’t. 

I tried to get used to it but whenever I try to be calm while using the app, a notification comes and puts my nerves on edge. 

I suggest that you develop communication preferences modes, where the user gets to choose how formal or friendly the app language is.
